Let's aim for the platform's columns to be 20-39 (three RIGHTs from 8-27? 8+12=20, 27+12=39, yes, three RIGHTs).
Then UP: the platform is at rows 20-23; the magenta's bottom edge is row 7. To reach rows 4-7, the platform needs to move up to rows 4-7: (20-4)/4 = 4 UPs. Then the platform would be at rows 4-7, columns 20-39, overlapping with the magenta's position (rows 4-7, columns 36-39). Collision!
